headline: 9 Stories That Shook
[[India's Business World]]
Today
hero.nudge: Netflix job cuts, an AI warning & more inside

stories.title: DMart Q2 Profit Rises [[8.5%]] to [[₹743 Cr]]
stories.line: Revenue grew 17.8% to ₹19,644 Cr, but the margin slipped from 7.3% to 7.1%.

stories.title: Brokerages Split on TCS: [[₹1,800]] to [[₹2,630]]
stories.line: Nomura says Buy at ₹2,630. Jefferies says Underperform at ₹1,800. The stock jumped over 5%.

stories.title: OpenAI, Anthropic Brace for an [[AI Crisis]] Within [[12 Months]]
stories.line: Axios says insiders fear a major AI incident in 6 to 12 months. Banks, internet and power are the top worry.

stories.title: Netflix May Cut [[~5%]] of Staff, Nearly [[800 Jobs]]
stories.line: Around 800 of its ~16,000 employees could be hit. Netflix has not confirmed it yet.

stories.title: Nat Habit Raises [[₹142 Cr]] in Series C
stories.line: Trident Growth Partners led the round. The plan: grow from 20,000 to 2 lakh stores in 3 years.

stories.title: Anand Rathi AUM Crosses [[₹1.08 Lakh Cr]]
stories.line: AUM grew 18%. Adjusted profit rose 22% to ₹121.9 Cr, plus a ₹4 dividend.

stories.title: Peak XV Sells [[₹47 Cr]] of Awfis Shares
stories.line: It sold 19.2 lakh shares at ₹245 each, or 2.68% of Awfis out of its 3.24% stake.

stories.title: NeoGrowth Raises [[₹85 Cr]] for MSME Loans
stories.line: The money comes from FMO and LeapFrog. The goal: a loan book of about ₹3,000 Cr.

stories.title: Axis AMC Launches SIF With [[₹10 Lakh]] Minimum
stories.line: SIFs sit between mutual funds and PMS, made for investors with bigger money.

recap: Peak XV sells ₹47 Cr Awfis stake
